A forklift is partially visible on the left side, interacting with the wood piles. The scene is dominated by the texture and geometry of the stacked lumber.

artifact_observations.location: Wood grain on central stack faces
artifact_observations.reasoning: Some wood faces exhibit slightly repetitive or 'painted-on' grain patterns lacking deep micro-texture, typical of AI generation, though subtle.
The forklift structure appears somewhat simplified and geometrically ambiguous where it meets the wood; the tines are not clearly defined penetrating the pallet/wood.
Slight warping in the vertical lines of the background lumber stacks, suggesting minor perspective inconsistency.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the scene is correctly classified as a lumbermill/sawmill and not just generic wood storage.
To verify the physical separation between the forklift and the wood stacks, and check for depth bleeding in the dense stacking.
To ensure individual planks have distinct boundaries and do not merge into each other (fusion artifacts).
To assess the realism of textures and lighting consistency across the complex scene.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the forklift interaction with the wood
Distinctness of boundaries between adjacent lumber planks
Geometric consistency of the stacked rows
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the forklift on the left; AI often struggles with the mechanical complexity of masts and tines. Check if the tines logically penetrate the load or if they float/merge. Also, inspect the wood grain for repetition or lack of depth, which is a common tell in generated wood textures.
